Cheryl - Oral Re: Bring the Registrar of Voters, Board of Supervisors and data team together to fix

 in November unless they hear issues from the public

election; cannot enforce identification without voting in person; clean up voter rolls and demand
identification to vote

Counsel Leon Page, City Counsel members and law enforcement agencies labeled him as being a 'mental
situation' which is disgraceful; has an IQ that is equivalent to Albert Einstein
